title: Hypothermia (dangerously cold)
scenario: Person exposed to cold or wet overnight, stuck outside. Shivering hard, confused, slurred speech, clumsy, unusually sleepy.
steps: Call 911 — confusion, slurred speech, or stopped shivering are signs of severe hypothermia.
Move them gently to a warm, dry place. Handle them carefully; rough movement can be dangerous.
Remove wet clothing and replace with dry layers.
Warm the center of the body first: chest, neck, head, and groin, with blankets, dry layers, or skin-to-skin contact under blankets.
If fully awake and able to swallow, give warm, sweet, non-alcoholic drinks.
Keep them wrapped and monitored until help arrives, even if they say they feel better.
do_not: Do not massage or rub their limbs.
Do not use direct high heat like scalding water or a heating pad on bare skin.
